module: Sends the vehicle data to the game engine (GE) Lua every frame so that it is recorded with the rest (test tool). The message is queued by obj:queueGameEngineLua and calls extensions.test_utRecorder.onVehicleData(vehId, dataTable) on the GE side.
notes: Table sent (indexed array, serialized with serialize): [1] input.throttle, [2] input.brake, [3] input.steering, [4] norm of the velocity obj:getVelocity() (m/s), [5] electrics.values.airspeed, [6] electrics.values.wheelspeed, [7] input.parkingbrake, [8] {x,y,z} position, [9] {x,y,z} forward direction.
nil values (e.g. missing airspeed) create holes in the array and the serialization may be affected.
On the GE side the target extension is called test_utRecorder: it must be loaded, otherwise the call fails.
Sent every frame with no rate limiting.

updateGFX.desc: Called every graphics frame (extensions.hook('updateGFX')). Builds the vehicle data table and sends it to extensions.test_utRecorder.onVehicleData on the GE side.
